notes_for_editor: Only source is the tnlandforms.us list. Name, county and coordinates match the record (record rounds 34.824). The list prints no elevation unit; feet is inferred, and 1,613 ft = 491.6 m matches the record. The datasheet reference EE1967 is unexplained; a search for EE1967 with Whitfield County returned no NGS datasheet page. Two WebSearch queries found no Rocky tower in Whitfield County. The hits were Rocky Face Mountain (a place name and an October 2016 brush fire) and a Dug Gap Mountain communications tower; neither is linked to this entry and neither is cited. NHLR has no page for it (404 on nhlr.org/lookouts/us/ga/rocky/). Status and access unknown, so no keys are set. Low confidence; deliberately short.
